<!--
  Gazebo entry point for the Mobile FR3 Duo v0.2 with BOTH sensor suites.

  ARCHITECTURE: Modular composition from source packages:
    - Layer 1: Base robot from franka_description
    - Layer 2a: Mobile platform sensors from franka_mobile_sensors  
    - Layer 2b: Vision kit accessories from franka_vision_and_manipulation_kit
    - Layer 3: Gazebo plugins applied by franka_gazebo_bringup

  Result: Robot with 10 sensors fully simulated in Gazebo
    - 4x RGB cameras (mobile platform) from franka_mobile_sensors
    - 2x LiDARs (mobile platform) from franka_mobile_sensors
    - 1x Body IMU (mobile platform) from franka_mobile_sensors
    - 2x Wrist cameras D405 (vision kit) from franka_vision_and_manipulation_kit
    - 1x Head camera ZED Mini (vision kit) from franka_vision_and_manipulation_kit
-->

<robot xmlns:xacro="http://www.ros.org/wiki/xacro" name="mobile_fr3_duo_v0_2_gazebo_sensors">

  <!-- ================================================================ -->
  <!-- Gazebo-specific argument overrides                               -->
  <!-- ================================================================ -->
  <!-- Declared before the description entry point is included so they win over its
       defaults: the mobile platform uses two-arm robot types and suppresses the
       self-collision capsule geometry. -->
  <xacro:arg name="robot_types"                     default="['tmrv0_2','fr3v2','fr3v2']" />
  <xacro:arg name="include_self_collision_geometry" default="false"/>

  <!-- Effort command interfaces for the Gazebo hardware plugin (Gazebo-only). -->
  <xacro:arg name="gazebo_effort" default="false"/>

  <!-- ================================================================ -->
  <!-- Includes                                                         -->
  <!-- ================================================================ -->

  <!-- Base robot (Layer 1): declares the shared args and calls the mobile macro with
       empty extras. -->
  <xacro:include filename="$(find franka_description)/robots/mobile_fr3_duo_v0_2/mobile_fr3_duo_v0_2.urdf.xacro"/>

  <!-- Mobile platform sensor components (Layer 2a) -->
  <xacro:include filename="$(find franka_mobile_sensors)/robots/sensor_suite.xacro"/>

  <!-- Vision kit accessory components (Layer 2b) -->
  <xacro:include filename="$(find franka_vision_and_manipulation_kit)/robots/vision_kit_components.xacro"/>

  <!-- ros2_control hardware interface macros + gazebo overlay macro -->
  <xacro:include filename="$(find franka_gazebo_bringup)/urdf/mobile_fr3_duo.ros2_control.xacro"/>
  <!-- Gazebo hardware-plugin block + gz_ros2_control system (owned by franka_gazebo_bringup) -->
  <xacro:include filename="$(find franka_gazebo_bringup)/urdf/franka_gazebo_hardware_plugins.xacro"/>
  <!-- Gazebo transmissions and SDF tag macros -->
  <xacro:include filename="$(find franka_gazebo_bringup)/urdf/franka_gazebo_transmissions.xacro"/>

  <!-- Gazebo sensor plugins (Layer 3) -->
  <xacro:include filename="$(find franka_gazebo_bringup)/urdf/sensors.xacro" />

  <!-- Per-arm prefixes consumed by the gazebo overlay (the mobile macro keeps these
       internal, so the entry point re-states them for the overlay). -->
  <xacro:property name="arm_prefixes_list" value="${['left','right']}"/>

  <!-- ================================================================ -->
  <!-- Base robot + transmissions + sensor accessories + ros2_control   -->
  <!-- (Layer 2a mobile platform + Layer 2b vision kit go in-between)   -->
  <!-- ================================================================ -->
  <xacro:mobile_fr3_duo_gazebo_composition>
    <sensor_layer>
      <xacro:sensor_suite />
      <xacro:vision_kit_components left_arm_type="fr3v2" right_arm_type="fr3v2" prefix="" robotiq_use_fake_hardware="true" robotiq_include_ros2_control="true" sim_gazebo="true" />
    </sensor_layer>
  </xacro:mobile_fr3_duo_gazebo_composition>

  <!-- ================================================================ -->
  <!-- LAYER 3: Gazebo Sensor Plugins                                  -->
  <!-- ================================================================ -->

  <!-- Mobile Platform Sensors (4x D455 RGB, 2x LiDAR, 1x IMU) -->
  <xacro:franka_gazebo_mobile_platform_sensors/>

  <!-- Vision Kit Sensors (2x D405 wrist, 1x ZED head) -->
  <xacro:franka_gazebo_vision_kit_sensors/>


</robot>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot xmlns:xacro="http://www.ros.org/wiki/xacro">


    <!-- Franka Gazebo IMU -->
    <xacro:macro name="franka_gazebo_imu" params="link_target gz_topic rate:=100">
        <gazebo reference="${link_target}">
            <sensor name="${link_target}" type="imu">
                <topic>${gz_topic}</topic>
                <always_on>true</always_on>
                <update_rate>${rate}</update_rate>
                <visualize>false</visualize>
                <plugin filename="libignition-gazebo-imu-system.so" name="ignition::gazebo::systems::Imu"/>
            </sensor>
      </gazebo>
    </xacro:macro>

    <!-- Franka Gazebo Arm IMUs -->
    <!-- Every joint has an IMU on both sides of the pcb -->
    <xacro:macro name="franka_gazebo_arm_imus" params="arm_prefix robot_type imu_side">
        <xacro:property name="prefix" value="${arm_prefix + '_' if arm_prefix else '' + robot_type}"/>
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_imu link_target="${prefix}_link0_accelerometer_${imu_side}" gz_topic="/${prefix}/imu/link0/${imu_side}"/>
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_imu link_target="${prefix}_link1_accelerometer_${imu_side}" gz_topic="/${prefix}/imu/link1/${imu_side}"/>
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_imu link_target="${prefix}_link2_accelerometer_${imu_side}" gz_topic="/${prefix}/imu/link2/${imu_side}"/>
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_imu link_target="${prefix}_link3_accelerometer_${imu_side}" gz_topic="/${prefix}/imu/link3/${imu_side}"/>
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_imu link_target="${prefix}_link4_accelerometer_${imu_side}" gz_topic="/${prefix}/imu/link4/${imu_side}"/>
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_imu link_target="${prefix}_link5_accelerometer_${imu_side}" gz_topic="/${prefix}/imu/link5/${imu_side}"/>
    </xacro:macro>

    <xacro:macro name="franka_gazebo_camera" params="link_reference sensor_name gz_topic
                 rate:=30 hfov:=1.047 width:=640 height:=480 format:=R8G8B8
                 clip_near:=0.1 clip_far:=100.0 visualize:=true">
        <gazebo reference="${link_reference}">
            <sensor name="${sensor_name}" type="camera">
                <pose>0 0 0 0 0 0</pose>
                <topic>${gz_topic}</topic>
                <update_rate>${rate}</update_rate>
                <camera>
                    <horizontal_fov>${hfov}</horizontal_fov>
                    <image>
                        <width>${width}</width>
                        <height>${height}</height>
                        <format>${format}</format>
                    </image>
                    <clip>
                        <near>${clip_near}</near>
                        <far>${clip_far}</far>
                    </clip>
                </camera>
                <always_on>true</always_on>
                <visualize>${visualize}</visualize>
            </sensor>
        </gazebo>
    </xacro:macro>

    <!-- ================= LIDAR MACRO ================= -->

    <xacro:macro name="franka_gazebo_lidar" params="link_reference sensor_name ros_topic
                 update_rate:=50.0 min_angle:='${radians(-45)}' max_angle:='${radians(225)}'
                 min_range:=0.05 max_range:=10.0 max_beams:=500
                 gaussian_noise:=0.006">
        <plugin
          filename="gz-sim-sensors-system"
          name="gz::sim::systems::Sensors">
          <render_engine>ogre2</render_engine>
        </plugin>
        <gazebo reference="${link_reference}">
            <material value="Gazebo/Yellow" />
            <sensor name="${sensor_name}" type="gpu_lidar">
                <topic>${ros_topic}</topic>
                <update_rate>${update_rate}</update_rate>
                <gz_frame_id>${link_reference}</gz_frame_id>
                <lidar>
                    <scan>
                        <horizontal>
                            <samples>${max_beams}</samples>
                            <resolution>1</resolution>
                            <min_angle>${min_angle}</min_angle>
                            <max_angle>${max_angle}</max_angle>
                        </horizontal>
                        <vertical>
                            <samples>16</samples>
                            <resolution>1</resolution>
                            <min_angle>-0.261799</min_angle>
                            <max_angle>0.261799</max_angle>
                        </vertical>
                    </scan>
                    <range>
                        <min>${min_range}</min>
                        <max>${max_range}</max>
                        <resolution>0.01</resolution>
                    </range>
                    <noise>
                        <type>gaussian</type>
                        <mean>0.0</mean>
                        <stddev>${gaussian_noise}</stddev>
                    </noise>
                </lidar>
                <visualize>true</visualize>
            </sensor>
        </gazebo>
    </xacro:macro>

    <!-- ================= BODY IMU MACRO ================= -->

    <xacro:macro name="franka_gazebo_body_imu" params="link_reference gz_topic rate:=100
                 gyro_stddev:=0.009 accel_stddev:=0.021">
        <gazebo reference="${link_reference}">
            <sensor name="imu_sensor" type="imu">
                <topic>${gz_topic}</topic>
                <update_rate>${rate}</update_rate>
                <always_on>true</always_on>
                <imu>
                    <angular_velocity>
                        <x><noise type="gaussian"><mean>0</mean><stddev>${gyro_stddev}</stddev></noise></x>
                        <y><noise type="gaussian"><mean>0</mean><stddev>${gyro_stddev}</stddev></noise></y>
                        <z><noise type="gaussian"><mean>0</mean><stddev>${gyro_stddev}</stddev></noise></z>
                    </angular_velocity>
                    <linear_acceleration>
                        <x><noise type="gaussian"><mean>0</mean><stddev>${accel_stddev}</stddev></noise></x>
                        <y><noise type="gaussian"><mean>0</mean><stddev>${accel_stddev}</stddev></noise></y>
                        <z><noise type="gaussian"><mean>0</mean><stddev>${accel_stddev}</stddev></noise></z>
                    </linear_acceleration>
                </imu>
            </sensor>
        </gazebo>
    </xacro:macro>

    <!-- ================= D405 REALSENSE CAMERA MACRO ================= -->

    <xacro:macro name="franka_gazebo_d405" params="link_reference sensor_name gz_topic
                 rate:=30 hfov:=1.047 width:=640 height:=480 format:=R8G8B8
                 clip_near:=0.1 clip_far:=100.0 visualize:=true">
        <gazebo reference="${link_reference}">
            <sensor name="${sensor_name}" type="camera">
                <pose>0 0 0 0 0 0</pose>
                <topic>${gz_topic}</topic>
                <update_rate>${rate}</update_rate>
                <camera>
                    <horizontal_fov>${hfov}</horizontal_fov>
                    <image>
                        <width>${width}</width>
                        <height>${height}</height>
                        <format>${format}</format>
                    </image>
                    <clip>
                        <near>${clip_near}</near>
                        <far>${clip_far}</far>
                    </clip>
                </camera>
                <always_on>true</always_on>
                <visualize>${visualize}</visualize>
            </sensor>
        </gazebo>
    </xacro:macro>

    <!-- ================= ZED CAMERA MACRO ================= -->

    <xacro:macro name="franka_gazebo_zed" params="link_reference sensor_name gz_topic
                 rate:=30 hfov:=1.5708 width:=672 height:=376 format:=R8G8B8
                 clip_near:=0.1 clip_far:=100.0 visualize:=true">
        <gazebo reference="${link_reference}">
            <sensor name="${sensor_name}" type="camera">
                <pose>0 0 0 0 0 0</pose>
                <topic>${gz_topic}</topic>
                <update_rate>${rate}</update_rate>
                <camera>
                    <horizontal_fov>${hfov}</horizontal_fov>
                    <image>
                        <width>${width}</width>
                        <height>${height}</height>
                        <format>${format}</format>
                    </image>
                    <clip>
                        <near>${clip_near}</near>
                        <far>${clip_far}</far>
                    </clip>
                </camera>
                <always_on>true</always_on>
                <visualize>${visualize}</visualize>
            </sensor>
        </gazebo>
    </xacro:macro>

    <!-- ================= CONVENIENCE MACROS FOR FUTURE VARIANTS ================= -->
    <!-- These macros provide reusable groups for common sensor configurations      -->
    <!-- Allows easy composition for future variants (e.g., FR3 Duo only)           -->

    <!-- All mobile platform sensors (RGB cameras, LiDARs, IMU) -->
    <xacro:macro name="franka_gazebo_mobile_platform_sensors">
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_camera link_reference="camera_front_link"
                                    sensor_name="camera_front"
                                    gz_topic="/camera_front/image_raw"/>
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_camera link_reference="camera_rear_link"
                                    sensor_name="camera_rear"
                                    gz_topic="/camera_rear/image_raw"/>
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_camera link_reference="camera_left_link"
                                    sensor_name="camera_left"
                                    gz_topic="/camera_left/image_raw"/>
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_camera link_reference="camera_right_link"
                                    sensor_name="camera_right"
                                    gz_topic="/camera_right/image_raw"/>
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_lidar link_reference="lidar_front"
                                    sensor_name="lidar_front"
                                    ros_topic="/lidar_front/scan"/>
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_lidar link_reference="lidar_rear"
                                    sensor_name="lidar_rear"
                                    ros_topic="/lidar_rear/scan"/>
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_body_imu link_reference="imu_body_link"
                                      gz_topic="/imu/data"/>
    </xacro:macro>

    <!-- All vision and manipulation kit sensors (wrist D405 + head ZED) -->
    <xacro:macro name="franka_gazebo_vision_kit_sensors">
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_d405 
            link_reference="left__wrist_camera_link"
            sensor_name="left_wrist_camera"
            gz_topic="/left_wrist_camera/image_raw"
            width="640" height="480" />
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_d405 
            link_reference="right__wrist_camera_link"
            sensor_name="right_wrist_camera"
            gz_topic="/right_wrist_camera/image_raw"
            width="640" height="480" />
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_zed 
            link_reference="head_camera_link"
            sensor_name="head_camera"
            gz_topic="/head_camera/image_raw"
            width="672" height="376" />
    </xacro:macro>

</robot>

<!--

  Includes the franka_description base robot and applies ros2_control
  hardware interface for gazebo simulation.
-->

<robot xmlns:xacro="http://www.ros.org/wiki/xacro" name="tmrv0_2_gazebo">

  <!-- ================================================================ -->
  <!-- Macro includes                                                    -->
  <!-- ================================================================ -->
  <xacro:include filename="$(find franka_description)/robots/tmrv0_2/tmrv0_2.xacro"/>
  <xacro:include filename="$(find franka_hardware)/ros2_control/tmrv0_2.ros2_control.xacro"/>
  <!-- Gazebo hardware-plugin block + gz_ros2_control system (owned by franka_gazebo_bringup) -->
  <xacro:include filename="$(find franka_gazebo_bringup)/urdf/franka_gazebo_hardware_plugins.xacro"/>

  <!-- ================================================================ -->
  <!-- Arguments                                                        -->
  <!-- ================================================================ -->
  <xacro:arg name="robot_type" default="tmrv0_2"/>
  <xacro:arg name="reduced_version" default="false"/>
  <xacro:arg name="robot_namespace" default=""/>

  <!-- ================================================================ -->
  <!-- Base robot (geometry only)                                       -->
  <!-- ================================================================ -->
  <xacro:tmrv0_2 mobile_robot_type="$(arg robot_type)"
    reduced_version="$(arg reduced_version)"
    robot_namespace="$(arg robot_namespace)"/>

  <!-- ================================================================ -->
  <!-- ros2_control hardware interface (gazebo mode)                    -->
  <!-- ================================================================ -->
  <xacro:tmrv0_2_ros2_control
    mobile_robot_type="$(arg robot_type)"
    include_passive_base="true">
    <hardware_plugin>
      <xacro:franka_gazebo_hardware_plugin/>
    </hardware_plugin>

  <xacro:franka_gazebo_ros2_control_system/>

</robot>

<!--
  Sensor demo world for the Mobile FR3 Duo.
  12 x 12 m enclosed room with coloured obstacles at varying
  heights and distances so cameras, lidars and IMU all have
  meaningful data to look at.

  Robot spawns at the origin facing +x.
-->
<sdf version="1.6">
  <world name="sensor_demo">

    <!-- ================================================================ -->
    <!-- PHYSICS                                                           -->
    <!-- ================================================================ -->
    <physics name="1ms" type="ignored">
      <max_step_size>0.001</max_step_size>
      <real_time_factor>1.0</real_time_factor>
    </physics>

    <!-- ================================================================ -->
    <!-- SYSTEM PLUGINS                                                    -->
    <!-- ================================================================ -->
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-physics-system"
            name="gz::sim::systems::Physics"/>
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-user-commands-system"
            name="gz::sim::systems::UserCommands"/>
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-scene-broadcaster-system"
            name="gz::sim::systems::SceneBroadcaster"/>
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-contact-system"
            name="gz::sim::systems::Contact"/>
    <!-- Camera and lidar rendering -->
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-sensors-system"
            name="gz::sim::systems::Sensors">
      <render_engine>ogre2</render_engine>
    </plugin>
    <!-- IMU -->
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-imu-system"
            name="gz::sim::systems::Imu"/>

    <!-- ================================================================ -->
    <!-- LIGHTING                                                          -->
    <!-- ================================================================ -->
    <light type="directional" name="sun">
      <cast_shadows>true</cast_shadows>
      <pose>0 0 10 0 0 0</pose>
      <diffuse>0.9 0.9 0.85 1</diffuse>
      <specular>0.3 0.3 0.3 1</specular>
      <attenuation>
        <range>1000</range><constant>0.9</constant>
        <linear>0.01</linear><quadratic>0.001</quadratic>
      </attenuation>
      <direction>-0.5 0.1 -0.9</direction>
    </light>

    <!-- Four ceiling point lights for even camera illumination -->
    <light type="point" name="ceil_ne">
      <pose>4 4 2.4 0 0 0</pose>
      <diffuse>1 1 1 1</diffuse><specular>0.2 0.2 0.2 1</specular>
      <attenuation><range>12</range><constant>0.4</constant>
        <linear>0.05</linear><quadratic>0.01</quadratic></attenuation>
      <cast_shadows>false</cast_shadows>
    </light>
    <light type="point" name="ceil_nw">
      <pose>-4 4 2.4 0 0 0</pose>
      <diffuse>1 1 1 1</diffuse><specular>0.2 0.2 0.2 1</specular>
      <attenuation><range>12</range><constant>0.4</constant>
        <linear>0.05</linear><quadratic>0.01</quadratic></attenuation>
      <cast_shadows>false</cast_shadows>
    </light>
    <light type="point" name="ceil_se">
      <pose>4 -4 2.4 0 0 0</pose>
      <diffuse>1 1 1 1</diffuse><specular>0.2 0.2 0.2 1</specular>
      <attenuation><range>12</range><constant>0.4</constant>
        <linear>0.05</linear><quadratic>0.01</quadratic></attenuation>
      <cast_shadows>false</cast_shadows>
    </light>
    <light type="point" name="ceil_sw">
      <pose>-4 -4 2.4 0 0 0</pose>
      <diffuse>1 1 1 1</diffuse><specular>0.2 0.2 0.2 1</specular>
      <attenuation><range>12</range><constant>0.4</constant>
        <linear>0.05</linear><quadratic>0.01</quadratic></attenuation>
      <cast_shadows>false</cast_shadows>
    </light>

    <!-- ================================================================ -->
    <!-- GROUND PLANE                                                      -->
    <!-- ================================================================ -->
    <model name="ground_plane">
      <static>true</static>
      <link name="link">
        <collision name="collision">
          <geometry><plane><normal>0 0 1</normal><size>100 100</size></plane></geometry>
        </collision>
        <visual name="visual">
          <geometry><plane><normal>0 0 1</normal><size>100 100</size></plane></geometry>
          <material>
            <ambient>0.45 0.45 0.45 1</ambient>
            <diffuse>0.45 0.45 0.45 1</diffuse>
            <specular>0.05 0.05 0.05 1</specular>
          </material>
        </visual>
      </link>
    </model>

    <!-- ================================================================ -->
    <!-- ROOM WALLS  (12 x 12 m interior, 2.5 m tall)                    -->

    <model name="wall_north">
      <static>true</static><pose>0 6 1.25 0 0 0</pose>
      <link name="link">
        <collision name="c"><geometry><box><size>12.4 0.2 2.5</size></box></geometry></collision>
        <visual name="v"><geometry><box><size>12.4 0.2 2.5</size></box></geometry>

        </visual>
      </link>
    </model>

    <model name="wall_south">
      <static>true</static><pose>0 -6 1.25 0 0 0</pose>
      <link name="link">
        <collision name="c"><geometry><box><size>12.4 0.2 2.5</size></box></geometry></collision>
        <visual name="v"><geometry><box><size>12.4 0.2 2.5</size></box></geometry>
          <material><ambient>0.82 0.82 0.78 1</ambient><diffuse>0.82 0.82 0.78 1</diffuse></material>
        </visual>
      </link>
    </model>

    <model name="wall_east">
      <static>true</static><pose>6 0 1.25 0 0 0</pose>
      <link name="link">
        <collision name="c"><geometry><box><size>0.2 12.4 2.5</size></box></geometry></collision>
        <visual name="v"><geometry><box><size>0.2 12.4 2.5</size></box></geometry>
          <material><ambient>0.82 0.82 0.78 1</ambient><diffuse>0.82 0.82 0.78 1</diffuse></material>
        </visual>
      </link>
    </model>

    <model name="wall_west">
      <static>true</static><pose>-6 0 1.25 0 0 0</pose>
      <link name="link">
        <collision name="c"><geometry><box><size>0.2 12.4 2.5</size></box></geometry></collision>
        <visual name="v"><geometry><box><size>0.2 12.4 2.5</size></box></geometry>
          <material><ambient>0.82 0.82 0.78 1</ambient><diffuse>0.82 0.82 0.78 1</diffuse></material>
        </visual>
      </link>
    </model>

    <!-- ================================================================ -->
    <!-- OBSTACLES                                                         -->
    <!-- All placed so cameras (front/rear/left/right) and both lidars    -->
    <!-- (safety scanners at ~19 cm height, up to 10 m range) see them.  -->
    <!-- ================================================================ -->

    <!-- RED box — directly ahead of robot (~2.5 m, front camera + lidar) -->
    <model name="box_red">
      <static>true</static><pose>2.5 0 0.3 0 0 0</pose>
      <link name="link">
        <collision name="c"><geometry><box><size>0.6 0.6 0.6</size></box></geometry></collision>
        <visual name="v"><geometry><box><size>0.6 0.6 0.6</size></box></geometry>
          <material>
            <ambient>0.85 0.12 0.12 1</ambient><diffuse>0.85 0.12 0.12 1</diffuse>
            <specular>0.4 0.1 0.1 1</specular>
          </material>
        </visual>
      </link>
    </model>

    <!-- BLUE tall pillar — front-left (camera + lidar) -->
    <model name="pillar_blue">

Changelog for package franka_gazebo_hardware
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

UNRELEASED
----------

* feat: new package holding the Gazebo (gz_ros2_control) system plugin
  ``franka_gazebo_hardware/GazeboGravityCompensationSystem``. The plugin computes
  pinocchio-based gravity torque and injects it on the effort-controlled Franka
  arm joints so the zero-torque example controllers behave as on the real robot
  instead of collapsing under their own weight. Split out of ``franka_gazebo_bringup``.
* feat: export the 16 ``<i>/cartesian_pose_state`` interfaces from the Gazebo hardware
  interface so Cartesian pose/impedance controllers can activate in simulation.
* feat: report the estimated external wrench in the stiffness frame K. ``K_F_ext_hat_K``
  and the ``_tcp`` force/torque interfaces are expressed in frame K, while
  ``O_F_ext_hat_K`` stays in the base frame. The wrench sign follows the reaction
  convention: a push in +x reads a measured external force of -x.

# gz_ros2_control provides the GazeboSimSystemInterface base class as headers
# only. Deliberately depend on it for include directories WITHOUT linking its
# libraries: libgz_hardware_plugins.so / libgz_ros2_control-system.so are
# class_loader/pluginlib plugins and must be loaded exclusively through pluginlib
# at runtime. Linking them (as ament_target_dependencies would) adds a DT_NEEDED
# that makes the dynamic loader run GazeboSimSystem's plugin registration outside
# class_loader's tracking, so the createSharedInstance("gz_ros2_control/GazeboSimSystem")
# call in initSim() then fails with "no factory exists for it".
# ${gz_ros2_control_INCLUDE_DIRS} carries the transitive dependency headers
# (controller_manager, hardware_interface, ...), and the imported system target
# carries the package's own include/gz_ros2_control prefix. Taking include
# directories only (never the target itself) keeps the plugin libraries off the
# link interface.
target_include_directories(franka_gz_hardware_plugins SYSTEM PUBLIC
        ${gz_ros2_control_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)
# Also pull the package's own include/gz_ros2_control prefix from the imported
# system target. Guard on target existence so a renamed/removed target in a
# future gz_ros2_control release fails loudly at configure time rather than
# silently dropping the include path (which would only surface as a build error).
if(TARGET gz_ros2_control::gz_ros2_control-system)
        target_include_directories(franka_gz_hardware_plugins SYSTEM PUBLIC
                $<TARGET_PROPERTY:gz_ros2_control::gz_ros2_control-system,INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES>
        )
elseif(NOT gz_ros2_control_INCLUDE_DIRS)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
                "gz_ros2_control provides neither the "
                "gz_ros2_control::gz_ros2_control-system imported target nor "
                "gz_ros2_control_INCLUDE_DIRS; cannot locate the "
                "GazeboSimSystemInterface headers.")
endif()

target_link_libraries(franka_gz_hardware_plugins
        gz-sim::gz-sim
        pinocchio::pinocchio
)

pluginlib_export_plugin_description_file(
        gz_ros2_control franka_gz_hardware_plugins.xml)

install(

install(

)

import os

from ament_index_python.packages import get_package_share_directory
from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import DeclareLaunchArgument, OpaqueFunction
from launch.conditions import IfCondition, UnlessCondition
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch_ros.actions import Node


def generate_robot_nodes(context):
    robot_ip = LaunchConfiguration('robot_ip').perform(context)
    use_fake_hardware = LaunchConfiguration('use_fake_hardware').perform(context)
    robot_type = LaunchConfiguration('robot_type').perform(context)
    namespace = LaunchConfiguration('namespace').perform(context)
    # Declare the launch argument names
    default_joint_name_postfix = '_finger_joint'
    joint_names_1 = robot_type + default_joint_name_postfix + '1'
    joint_names_2 = robot_type + default_joint_name_postfix + '2'
    joint_names = [joint_names_1, joint_names_2]

    nodes = []

    # Load the gripper configuration file
    gripper_config = os.path.join(
        get_package_share_directory('franka_gripper'), 'config', 'franka_gripper_node.yaml'
    )
    nodes.append(
        Node(
                package='franka_gripper',
                executable='franka_gripper_node',
                name=['franka_gripper'],
                namespace=namespace,
                parameters=[{'robot_ip': robot_ip, 'joint_names': joint_names}, gripper_config],
                condition=UnlessCondition(use_fake_hardware),
        )
    )
    nodes.append(
        Node(
            package='franka_gripper',
            executable='fake_gripper_state_publisher.py',
            name=['franka_gripper'],
            namespace=namespace,
            parameters=[{'robot_ip': robot_ip, 'joint_names': joint_names}, gripper_config],
            condition=IfCondition(use_fake_hardware),
        )
    )
    return nodes


def generate_launch_description():
    return LaunchDescription(
        [
            DeclareLaunchArgument(
                'robot_ip',
                description='Hostname or IP address of the robot.'
            ),
            DeclareLaunchArgument(
                'use_fake_hardware',
                default_value='false',
                description=(
                    'Publish fake gripper joint states without connecting to a real gripper'
                ),
            ),
            DeclareLaunchArgument(
                'robot_type',
                default_value='fr3',

#  limitations under the License.

import rclpy
from rclpy import Parameter
from rclpy.node import Node
from sensor_msgs.msg import JointState


class FakeGripperStatePublisher(Node):

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__('fake_gripper_state_publisher')
        self.publisher_ = self.create_publisher(JointState, '~/joint_states', 1)
        timer_period = 0.1  # seconds

        self.declare_parameter('joint_names', Parameter.Type.STRING_ARRAY)
        self.joint_names = (
            self.get_parameter('joint_names').get_parameter_value().string_array_value
        )

        assert len(self.joint_names) == 2
        self.timer = self.create_timer(timer_period, self.publish_state)

    def publish_state(self):
        joint_states = JointState()
        joint_states.header.stamp = self.get_clock().now().to_msg()
        joint_states.name = self.joint_names
        joint_states.position = [0.035, 0.035]
        joint_states.velocity = [0.0, 0.0]
        joint_states.effort = [0.0, 0.0]
        self.publisher_.publish(joint_states)


def main(args=None):
    rclpy.init(args=args)

    state_publisher = FakeGripperStatePublisher()

    rclpy.spin(state_publisher)
    state_publisher.destroy_node()
    rclpy.shutdown()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot xmlns:xacro="http://www.ros.org/wiki/xacro">

  <xacro:include filename="$(find franka_hardware)/ros2_control/franka_ros2_control_macros.xacro"/>

  <xacro:macro name="franka_arm_ros2_control"
    params="robot_type
                 include_effort_command:=true
                 include_finger_joint:=false
                 arm_prefix:=''
                 is_async:=false
                 thread_priority:=98
                 **hardware_plugin">

    <ros2_control name="${arm_prefix}FrankaHardwareInterface" type="system" is_async="${is_async}">
      <xacro:if value="${is_async}">
        <properties>
          <async scheduling_policy="detached" print_warnings="true" thread_priority="${thread_priority}"
            manage_overruns="false"/>
        </properties>
      </xacro:if>
      <hardware>
        <param name="version">1.1.0</param>
        <param name="robot_type">${robot_type}</param>
        <param name="prefix">${arm_prefix}</param>
        <xacro:insert_block name="hardware_plugin"/>
      </hardware>

      <!-- Per-arm interfaces: joints, finger, cartesian velocity, cartesian pose, elbow, sensor -->
      <xacro:configure_arm_interfaces
          joint_prefix="${arm_prefix}${robot_type}"
          gpio_prefix="${arm_prefix}"
          include_effort_command="${include_effort_command}"
          include_finger_joint="${include_finger_joint}"
          include_elbow="1"
          include_cartesian_pose="1"
          include_sensor="1"
          sensor_name="${arm_prefix}${robot_type}_tcp"/>

    </ros2_control>

  </xacro:macro>
</robot>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!--
  Hardware-plugin blocks for the single-arm ros2_control interface, owned by franka_hardware.

  These macros emit only the <plugin> element plus its plugin-specific <param>s. They are
  injected into the franka_arm_ros2_control macro via its **hardware_plugin block param, so
  the plugin-selection knowledge lives alongside the ros2_control interface in franka_hardware.
-->
<robot xmlns:xacro="http://www.ros.org/wiki/xacro">

  <!-- Real robot: franka_hardware FrankaHardwareInterface driving the arm over robot_ip. -->
  <xacro:macro name="franka_real_hardware_plugin" params="robot_ip:='' arm_prefix:=''">
    <plugin>franka_hardware/FrankaHardwareInterface</plugin>
    <param name="robot_ip">${robot_ip}</param>
    <param name="arm_prefix">${arm_prefix}</param>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Fake hardware: ros2_control generic mock system. -->
  <xacro:macro name="franka_mock_hardware_plugin" params="fake_sensor_commands:=false">
    <plugin>mock_components/GenericSystem</plugin>
    <param name="mock_sensor_commands">${fake_sensor_commands}</param>
    <param name="state_following_offset">0.0</param>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Selects the mock or real single-arm plugin from use_fake_hardware, so call sites emit
       one macro instead of a duplicated if/unless pair. -->
  <xacro:macro name="franka_selected_arm_hardware_plugin"
    params="use_fake_hardware robot_ip:='' arm_prefix:='' fake_sensor_commands:=false">
    <xacro:if value="${use_fake_hardware}">
      <xacro:franka_mock_hardware_plugin fake_sensor_commands="${fake_sensor_commands}"/>
    </xacro:if>
    <xacro:unless value="${use_fake_hardware}">
      <xacro:franka_real_hardware_plugin robot_ip="${robot_ip}" arm_prefix="${arm_prefix}"/>
    </xacro:unless>
  </xacro:macro>

</robot>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot xmlns:xacro="http://www.ros.org/wiki/xacro">

  <!-- Configure a single Franka arm joint with position/velocity/conditional-effort commands -->
  <xacro:macro name="configure_arm_joint" params="joint_name initial_position include_effort_command:=1">
    <joint name="${joint_name}">
      <command_interface name="position"/>
      <command_interface name="velocity"/>
      <xacro:if value="${include_effort_command}">
        <command_interface name="effort"/>
      </xacro:if>
      <state_interface name="position">
        <param name="initial_value">${initial_position}</param>
      </state_interface>
      <state_interface name="velocity"/>
      <state_interface name="effort"/>
    </joint>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Configure all 7 arm joints for a given prefix with standard initial positions -->
  <xacro:macro name="configure_arm_joints" params="joint_prefix include_effort_command:=1">
    <xacro:configure_arm_joint joint_name="${joint_prefix}_joint1" initial_position="0.0" include_effort_command="${include_effort_command}"/>
    <xacro:configure_arm_joint joint_name="${joint_prefix}_joint2" initial_position="${-pi/4}" include_effort_command="${include_effort_command}"/>
    <xacro:configure_arm_joint joint_name="${joint_prefix}_joint3" initial_position="0.0" include_effort_command="${include_effort_command}"/>
    <xacro:configure_arm_joint joint_name="${joint_prefix}_joint4" initial_position="${-3*pi/4}" include_effort_command="${include_effort_command}"/>
    <xacro:configure_arm_joint joint_name="${joint_prefix}_joint5" initial_position="0.0" include_effort_command="${include_effort_command}"/>
    <xacro:configure_arm_joint joint_name="${joint_prefix}_joint6" initial_position="${pi/2}" include_effort_command="${include_effort_command}"/>
    <xacro:configure_arm_joint joint_name="${joint_prefix}_joint7" initial_position="${pi/4}" include_effort_command="${include_effort_command}"/>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Configure a finger joint (position_only=1: only a position command, no velocity/effort) -->
  <xacro:macro name="configure_finger_joint" params="joint_name include_effort_command:=1 position_only:=0">
    <joint name="${joint_name}">
      <command_interface name="position"/>
      <xacro:unless value="${position_only}">
        <command_interface name="velocity"/>
        <xacro:if value="${include_effort_command}">
          <command_interface name="effort"/>
        </xacro:if>
      </xacro:unless>
      <state_interface name="position">
        <param name="initial_value">0.0</param>
      </state_interface>
      <state_interface name="velocity"/>
      <state_interface name="effort"/>
    </joint>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Emit the arm joints (and optional finger joint) for both arms of a dual-arm gazebo
       ros2_control block. gz_ros2_control supports only joint command interfaces, so this
       covers the full per-arm joint set. finger_position_only threads through to
       configure_finger_joint (default 1: single position command, avoids the
       gz_ros2_control position+velocity command interface bug). -->
  <xacro:macro name="configure_duo_gazebo_arm_joints"
    params="arm1_prefix arm1_type arm2_prefix arm2_type
            include_effort_command:=1 include_finger_joint:=0
            finger_position_only:=1">
    <!-- Left arm joints -->
    <xacro:configure_arm_joints joint_prefix="${arm1_prefix}_${arm1_type}" include_effort_command="${include_effort_command}"/>
    <xacro:if value="${include_finger_joint}">
      <xacro:configure_finger_joint joint_name="${arm1_prefix}_${arm1_type}_finger_joint1" include_effort_command="${include_effort_command}" position_only="${finger_position_only}"/>
    </xacro:if>
    <!-- Right arm joints -->
    <xacro:configure_arm_joints joint_prefix="${arm2_prefix}_${arm2_type}" include_effort_command="${include_effort_command}"/>
    <xacro:if value="${include_finger_joint}">
      <xacro:configure_finger_joint joint_name="${arm2_prefix}_${arm2_type}_finger_joint1" include_effort_command="${include_effort_command}" position_only="${finger_position_only}"/>
    </xacro:if>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- A state-only joint: position + velocity state interfaces, no command interfaces -->
  <xacro:macro name="passive_joint" params="joint_name">
    <joint name="${joint_name}">
      <state_interface name="position">
        <param name="initial_value">0.0</param>
      </state_interface>
      <state_interface name="velocity">
        <param name="initial_value">0.0</param>
      </state_interface>
    </joint>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Configure a steering joint: position command, position + velocity state -->
  <xacro:macro name="configure_steering_joint" params="joint_name">
    <joint name="${joint_name}">
      <command_interface name="position"/>
      <state_interface name="position">
        <param name="initial_value">0.0</param>
      </state_interface>
      <state_interface name="velocity">
        <param name="initial_value">0.0</param>
      </state_interface>
    </joint>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Configure a driving joint: velocity command, position + velocity state -->
  <xacro:macro name="configure_driving_joint" params="joint_name">
    <joint name="${joint_name}">
      <command_interface name="velocity"/>
      <state_interface name="position">
        <param name="initial_value">0.0</param>
      </state_interface>
      <state_interface name="velocity">
        <param name="initial_value">0.0</param>
      </state_interface>
    </joint>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- General-purpose GPIO entry (caller provides full prefix including any arm namespace) -->
  <xacro:macro name="general_purpose_io" params="prefix command_interface index">
    <gpio name="${prefix}">
      <command_interface name="${command_interface}"/>
      <param name="index">${index}</param>
    </gpio>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Emit 6 cartesian_velocity GPIO entries (vx, vy, vz, wx, wy, wz) for a given prefix -->
  <xacro:macro name="cartesian_velocity_io" params="prefix:=''">
    <xacro:general_purpose_io prefix="${prefix}vx" command_interface="cartesian_velocity" index="0"/>
    <xacro:general_purpose_io prefix="${prefix}vy" command_interface="cartesian_velocity" index="1"/>
    <xacro:general_purpose_io prefix="${prefix}vz" command_interface="cartesian_velocity" index="2"/>
    <xacro:general_purpose_io prefix="${prefix}wx" command_interface="cartesian_velocity" index="3"/>
    <xacro:general_purpose_io prefix="${prefix}wy" command_interface="cartesian_velocity" index="4"/>
    <xacro:general_purpose_io prefix="${prefix}wz" command_interface="cartesian_velocity" index="5"/>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Configure the 4 TMR drive joints (2 steering + 2 driving) -->
  <xacro:macro name="configure_mobile_drive_joints" params="mobile_robot_type">
    <xacro:configure_steering_joint joint_name="${mobile_robot_type}_joint_0"/>
    <xacro:configure_driving_joint joint_name="${mobile_robot_type}_joint_1"/>
    <xacro:configure_steering_joint joint_name="${mobile_robot_type}_joint_2"/>
    <xacro:configure_driving_joint joint_name="${mobile_robot_type}_joint_3"/>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Configure passive base joints: rocker arm + front/rear casters (state-only) -->
  <xacro:macro name="configure_passive_mobile_base_joints" params="include_spine:=0">
    <xacro:if value="${include_spine}">
      <!-- Spine: the prismatic spine carries the full upper-body weight. With
           gravity enabled globally in the simulator it would collapse unless
           actively held, so (this macro is only instantiated when the passive
           base joints are emitted) it gets a position command interface and is
           held at its initial height by spine_joint_trajectory_controller.
           gz_ros2_control issue #343 (position+velocity command interface bug)
           does not apply here: the spine declares only a single position command
           interface. -->
      <joint name="franka_spine_vertical_joint">
        <command_interface name="position"/>
        <state_interface name="position">
          <param name="initial_value">0.0</param>
        </state_interface>
        <state_interface name="velocity">
          <param name="initial_value">0.0</param>
        </state_interface>
      </joint>
    </xacro:if>

    <!-- Rocker Arm -->
    <xacro:passive_joint joint_name="rocker_arm_joint"/>
    <!-- Front caster -->
    <xacro:passive_joint joint_name="caster_front_left_steering_joint"/>
    <xacro:passive_joint joint_name="caster_front_left_joint"/>
    <!-- Rear caster -->
    <xacro:passive_joint joint_name="caster_rear_right_steering_joint"/>
    <xacro:passive_joint joint_name="caster_rear_right_joint"/>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Recursive loop for cartesian_pose_command (16 entries) -->
  <xacro:macro name="cartesian_pose_loop" params="arm_prefix i">
    <xacro:unless value="${i == 16}">
      <xacro:general_purpose_io prefix="${arm_prefix}${i}" command_interface="cartesian_pose_command" index="${i}"/>
      <xacro:cartesian_pose_loop arm_prefix="${arm_prefix}" i="${i+1}"/>
    </xacro:unless>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Complete per-arm interface set: joints + finger + cartesian_velocity + elbow + cartesian_pose + sensor.
       Each component is optional via boolean flags. Indices start at 0 (single-arm hardware block). -->
  <xacro:macro name="configure_arm_interfaces"
    params="joint_prefix gpio_prefix include_effort_command:=1 include_finger_joint:=0
            include_elbow:=0
            include_cartesian_pose:=0
            include_sensor:=0 sensor_name:=''
            finger_position_only:=0">

    <!-- 7 arm joints (position/velocity/conditional-effort) -->
    <xacro:configure_arm_joints joint_prefix="${joint_prefix}" include_effort_command="${include_effort_command}"/>

    <!-- Optional finger joint -->
    <xacro:if value="${include_finger_joint}">
      <xacro:configure_finger_joint joint_name="${joint_prefix}_finger_joint1" include_effort_command="${include_effort_command}" position_only="${finger_position_only}"/>
    </xacro:if>

    <!-- Cartesian velocity GPIOs (6 entries: vx–wz) -->
    <xacro:cartesian_velocity_io prefix="${gpio_prefix}"/>

    <!-- Elbow command GPIOs (2 entries: joint_3_position, joint_4_sign) -->
    <xacro:if value="${include_elbow}">

  mock additionally enables mock_gpio_commands, and the TMR real plugin carries no arm_prefix.

  <!-- Real mobile base: franka_hardware FrankaHardwareInterface driving the TMR over robot_ip. -->
  <xacro:macro name="tmrv0_2_real_hardware_plugin" params="robot_ip:=''">
    <plugin>franka_hardware/FrankaHardwareInterface</plugin>
    <param name="robot_ip">${robot_ip}</param>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Fake hardware: ros2_control generic mock system with mocked GPIO. -->
  <xacro:macro name="tmrv0_2_mock_hardware_plugin" params="fake_sensor_commands:=false">
    <plugin>mock_components/GenericSystem</plugin>
    <param name="mock_gpio_commands">true</param>
    <param name="mock_sensor_commands">${fake_sensor_commands}</param>
    <param name="state_following_offset">0.0</param>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Selects the mock or real TMR-base plugin from use_fake_hardware, so call sites emit
       one macro instead of a duplicated if/unless pair. -->
  <xacro:macro name="tmrv0_2_selected_hardware_plugin"
    params="use_fake_hardware robot_ip:='' fake_sensor_commands:=false">
    <xacro:if value="${use_fake_hardware}">
      <xacro:tmrv0_2_mock_hardware_plugin fake_sensor_commands="${fake_sensor_commands}"/>
    </xacro:if>

      <xacro:tmrv0_2_real_hardware_plugin robot_ip="${robot_ip}"/>

"""ROS 2 battery node for the Franka TMR Battery REST API."""

from franka_mobile.battery_controller import BatteryController
import rclpy
from rclpy.callback_groups import ReentrantCallbackGroup
from rclpy.executors import MultiThreadedExecutor
from rclpy.node import Node
from sensor_msgs.msg import BatteryState
from std_srvs.srv import Trigger

#: Default HTTP request timeout in seconds.
DEFAULT_HTTP_TIMEOUT = 20.0

#: Default battery topic publish rate in Hz.
DEFAULT_PUBLISH_RATE = 1.0


class BatteryServer(Node):
    """Publishes BatteryState and exposes Trigger services for wireless charging control."""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__('franka_battery_node')

        self.declare_parameter('robot_ip', '')
        self.declare_parameter('http_timeout', DEFAULT_HTTP_TIMEOUT)
        self.declare_parameter('publish_rate', DEFAULT_PUBLISH_RATE)
        self.declare_parameter('enable_battery_topic', True)

        robot_ip = self.get_parameter('robot_ip').get_parameter_value().string_value
        if not robot_ip:
            self.get_logger().fatal("Parameter 'robot_ip' not set")
            raise ValueError("Parameter 'robot_ip' not set")

        http_timeout = self.get_parameter('http_timeout').get_parameter_value().double_value
        publish_rate = self.get_parameter('publish_rate').get_parameter_value().double_value
        enable_battery_topic = (
            self.get_parameter('enable_battery_topic').get_parameter_value().bool_value
        )

        self.controller = BatteryController(
            robot_ip,
            timeout=http_timeout,
            logger=self.get_logger(),
        )
        self.get_logger().info(f'Battery controller initialized for {robot_ip}')

        reentrant_callback_group = ReentrantCallbackGroup()
        self.stop_wireless_charging_service = self.create_service(
            Trigger,
            '~/stop_wireless_charging',
            self._stop_wireless_charging_callback,
            callback_group=reentrant_callback_group,
        )
        self.try_start_wireless_charging_service = self.create_service(
            Trigger,
            '~/try_start_wireless_charging',
            self._try_start_wireless_charging_callback,
            callback_group=reentrant_callback_group,
        )

        self._battery_publisher = None
        self._publish_timer = None
        if enable_battery_topic:
            if publish_rate <= 0.0:
                self.get_logger().warn(
                    'publish_rate must be > 0 to enable the battery topic; topic disabled'
                )
            else:
                self._battery_publisher = self.create_publisher(BatteryState, '~/battery_state', 10)
                period = 1.0 / publish_rate
                self._publish_timer = self.create_timer(
                    period,
                    self._publish_battery_state,
                    callback_group=reentrant_callback_group,
                )
                self.get_logger().info(
                    f'Publishing sensor_msgs/BatteryState on ~/battery_state at {publish_rate} Hz'
                )

        self.get_logger().info('Battery server ready')

    def _stop_wireless_charging_callback(self, _request, response):
        result = self.controller.stop_wireless_charging()
        response.success = result.success
        response.message = result.message
        return response

    def _try_start_wireless_charging_callback(self, _request, response):
        result = self.controller.try_start_wireless_charging()
        response.success = result.success
        response.message = result.message
        return response

    def _to_battery_state(self, states) -> BatteryState:
        msg = BatteryState()
        msg.header.stamp = self.get_clock().now().to_msg()
        msg.percentage = float(states.battery_level_rsoc) / 100.0
        msg.present = True

        if states.wireless_charging_active or states.wired_charging_active:
            msg.power_supply_status = BatteryState.POWER_SUPPLY_STATUS_CHARGING
        elif states.battery_level_rsoc >= 100:
            msg.power_supply_status = BatteryState.POWER_SUPPLY_STATUS_FULL
        else:
            msg.power_supply_status = BatteryState.POWER_SUPPLY_STATUS_DISCHARGING

        if states.wireless_charging_active:
            msg.location = 'wireless'
        elif states.wired_charging_active:
            msg.location = 'wired'
        else:
            msg.location = ''

        msg.power_supply_technology = BatteryState.POWER_SUPPLY_TECHNOLOGY_UNKNOWN
        msg.power_supply_health = BatteryState.POWER_SUPPLY_HEALTH_UNKNOWN
        if states.mob_charging_unit_errors:
            msg.power_supply_health = BatteryState.POWER_SUPPLY_HEALTH_UNSPEC_FAILURE

        msg.voltage = float('nan')
        msg.temperature = states.temperatures.batt_pos_terminal
        msg.current = float('nan')
        msg.charge = float('nan')
        msg.capacity = float('nan')
        msg.design_capacity = float('nan')
        return msg

    def _publish_battery_state(self):
        """Poll system-states and publish a standard BatteryState at a low rate."""
        result = self.controller.get_system_states()
        if not result.success:
            self.get_logger().warn(
                f'Failed to publish battery state: {result.message}',
                throttle_duration_sec=5.0,
            )
            return

        self._battery_publisher.publish(self._to_battery_state(result))


def main(args=None):
    rclpy.init(args=args)
    node = BatteryServer()
    executor = MultiThreadedExecutor()
    executor.add_node(node)
    try:
        executor.spin()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        node.destroy_node()
        rclpy.shutdown()

    print('Battery server shut down gracefully')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import os

from ament_index_python.packages import get_package_share_directory
from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import DeclareLaunchArgument, OpaqueFunction
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch_ros.actions import Node


def generate_robot_nodes(context):
    robot_ip = LaunchConfiguration('robot_ip').perform(context)
    namespace = LaunchConfiguration('namespace').perform(context)

    battery_config = os.path.join(
        get_package_share_directory('franka_mobile'),
        'config',
        'franka_battery_node.yaml',
    )

    nodes = [
        Node(
            package='franka_mobile',
            executable='battery_server_node.py',
            name='franka_battery_node',
            namespace=namespace,
            parameters=[{'robot_ip': robot_ip}, battery_config],
            output='screen',
        ),
    ]
    return nodes


def generate_launch_description():
    return LaunchDescription(
        [
            DeclareLaunchArgument(
                'robot_ip',
                description='IP address or hostname of the Franka TMR robot.',
            ),
            DeclareLaunchArgument(
                'namespace',
                default_value='',
                description='Namespace for the battery node.',
            ),
            OpaqueFunction(function=generate_robot_nodes),
        ]
    )

# mobile FR3 Duo Moveit Integration

## Moveit Setup Assistant


```sh
sudo apt install ros-jazzy-gz-ros2-control
sudo apt install ros-jazzy-moveit
sudo apt install ros-jazzy-moveit-setup-assistant


ros2 launch moveit_setup_assistant setup_assistant.launch.py
```

> [!WARNING]
> There is an  rviz bug: https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/issues/3546, which will cause the assistant to crash when trying to load the URDF

To fix that issue do this:

```sh
sudo apt install wget
wget http://snapshots.ros.org/jazzy/2025-05-23/ubuntu/pool/main/r/ros-jazzy-rviz-common/ros-jazzy-rviz-common_14.1.11-1noble.20250520.201719_amd64.deb

sudo apt remove ros-jazzy-rviz2
sudo dpkg -i ros-jazzy-rviz-common_14.1.11-1noble.20250520.201719_amd64.deb
```

When selecting `src/franka_description/robots/mobile_fr3_duo_v0_2/mobile_fr3_duo_v0_2.urdf.xacro` for the URDF, you may want to add arguments like these `hand:="false" load_gripper:="false" ee_id:="None"`

Follow the [setup_assistant_tutorial](https://moveit.picknik.ai/main/doc/examples/setup_assistant/setup_assistant_tutorial.html).

### MoveGroups

For the mobile base, defining a planar joint was useful for planning. TBD if this can stay.
This move group structure worked for me:

```xml
    <group name="right_arm">
        <joint /> <!-- same as tutorial -->
    </group>
    <group name="left_arm">
        <joint /> <!-- same as tutorial -->
    </group>
    <group name="mobile_base">
        <joint name="planar_x"/> <!-- important -->
        <joint name="planar_y"/> <!-- important -->
        <joint name="planar_theta"/> <!-- important -->
    </group>
    <group name="spine">
        <joint name="franka_spine_vertical_joint"/> <!-- maybe drop until actions are there -->
    </group>
    <group name="left_hand">
        <link /> <!-- same as tutorial -->
    </group>
    <group name="right_hand">
        <link /> <!-- same as tutorial -->
    </group>
    <group name="full_body">
        <group name="right_arm"/>
        <group name="left_arm"/>
        <group name="mobile_base"/>
        <group name="spine"/>
    </group>
```

With these settings, the complete configs can be generated.

### Joint Limits

The planner won't succeed if a joint belonging to the move group, was not manually configured in the `joint_limits.yaml` to have a `has_acceleration_limits: true` and a `max_acceleration: <value>`.


## Demo

Build, source and launch the created package like this:

```sh
colcon build --packages-up-to franka_mobile_fr3_duo_moveit_config
source install/setup.bash
export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=201 # optional but recommended 
ros2 launch franka_mobile_fr3_duo_moveit_config moveit.launch.py use_fake_hardware:=true simulate_in_gazebo:=false # for just fake hardware
ros2 launch franka_mobile_fr3_duo_moveit_config moveit.launch.py use_fake_hardware:=false simulate_in_gazebo:=true # using gazebo
ros2 launch franka_mobile_fr3_duo_moveit_config moveit.launch.py use_fake_hardware:=false simulate_in_gazebo:=false # using real hardware
```

In Rviz, select `full_body` as "Planning Group", `<random_valid>` as "Goal State" and increase the "Velocity Scaling" and "Accel. Scaling", then click "Plan" for a quick demo, or play with the 3D markers to your liking:

![full_body](./img/moveit_demo_prototype.gif)

import os
from ament_index_python import get_package_share_directory
import xacro


def get_robot_descriptions(robot_name, simulate_in_gazebo):
    """Return (robot_description, robot_description_semantic) XML strings."""
    robot_description_file_path = os.path.join(
        get_package_share_directory('franka_mobile_fr3_duo_moveit_config'),
        'urdf',
        f'{robot_name}.moveit.urdf.xacro',
    )

    robot_description_semantic_file_path = os.path.join(
        get_package_share_directory('franka_description'),
        'robots',
        robot_name,
        f'{robot_name}.srdf.xacro',
    )

    robot_description = xacro.process_file(
        robot_description_file_path,
        mappings={
            'simulate_in_gazebo': simulate_in_gazebo,
            'gazebo_effort': simulate_in_gazebo,
        },
    ).toxml()

    robot_description_semantic = xacro.process_file(
        robot_description_semantic_file_path,
        mappings={},
    ).toxml()

    return robot_description, robot_description_semantic

import json
import os
import yaml
from ament_index_python.packages import get_package_share_directory

PACKAGE_NAME = 'franka_mobile_fr3_duo_moveit_config'


def load_config_yaml(file_name):
    """Load a YAML config file from this package's config directory."""
    config_yaml_path = os.path.join(
        get_package_share_directory(PACKAGE_NAME),
        'config',
        file_name,
    )
    with open(config_yaml_path, 'r') as file:
        return yaml.load(file, Loader=yaml.FullLoader)


def load_moveit_defaults():
    """Load moveit_defaults.json from this package's config directory."""
    moveit_defaults_path = os.path.join(
        get_package_share_directory(PACKAGE_NAME),
        'config',
        'moveit_defaults.json',
    )
    with open(moveit_defaults_path, 'r') as file:
        return json.load(file)


def build_move_group_params(
    robot_description,
    robot_description_semantic,
    kinematics,
    joint_limits,
    trajectory_execution,
    moveit_defaults,
    simulate_in_gazebo,
):
    """Build the parameter list for the move_group node."""
    move_group_configuration = {
        'robot_description': robot_description,
        'publish_robot_description': True,
        'robot_description_kinematics': kinematics,
        'robot_description_semantic': robot_description_semantic,
        'robot_description_planning': joint_limits,
    }

    extra_params = {
        'allow_trajectory_execution': True,
        'capabilities': '',
        'disable_capabilities': '',
        'publish_robot_description_semantic': True,
        'publish_planning_scene': True,
        'publish_geometry_updates': True,
        'publish_state_updates': True,
        'publish_transforms_updates': True,
        'monitor_dynamics': False,
        'use_sim_time': simulate_in_gazebo,
    }

    move_group_configuration.update(moveit_defaults)
    move_group_configuration.update(trajectory_execution)
    move_group_configuration.update(extra_params)

    return [move_group_configuration, extra_params]


def get_parameters():
    kinematics = load_config_yaml('kinematics.yaml')
    joint_limits = load_config_yaml('joint_limits.yaml')
    trajectory_execution = load_config_yaml('moveit_controllers.yaml')
    moveit_defaults = load_moveit_defaults()
    return [kinematics, joint_limits, trajectory_execution, moveit_defaults]


def get_combined_parameters(robot_description, robot_description_semantic, simulate_in_gazebo):
    [kinematics, joint_limits, trajectory_execution, moveit_defaults] = get_parameters()
    return build_move_group_params(
        robot_description,
        robot_description_semantic,
        kinematics,
        joint_limits,
        trajectory_execution,
        moveit_defaults,
        simulate_in_gazebo,
    )


def get_rviz_parameters(simulate_in_gazebo):
    [kinematics, joint_limits, _, moveit_defaults] = get_parameters()
    return [
        {'planning_pipelines': moveit_defaults['planning_pipelines']},
        {'default_planning_pipeline': moveit_defaults['default_planning_pipeline']},
        {'robot_description_kinematics': kinematics},
        {'robot_description_planning': joint_limits},
        {'use_sim_time': simulate_in_gazebo},
    ]

import os
from ament_index_python import get_package_share_directory
from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import (
    DeclareLaunchArgument,
    OpaqueFunction,
    RegisterEventHandler,
    IncludeLaunchDescription,
)
from launch.launch_description_sources import PythonLaunchDescriptionSource
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration, PathJoinSubstitution
from launch_ros.actions import Node
from launch_ros.substitutions import FindPackageShare
from launch.event_handlers import OnProcessExit
from franka_mobile_fr3_duo_moveit_config.description import get_robot_descriptions
from franka_mobile_fr3_duo_moveit_config.parameters import (
    get_combined_parameters,
    get_rviz_parameters,
)


PACKAGE_NAME = 'franka_mobile_fr3_duo_moveit_config'


def set_gz_sim_resource_path(context):
    description_share = os.path.dirname(get_package_share_directory('franka_description'))
    os.environ['GZ_SIM_RESOURCE_PATH'] = description_share
    return []


def get_gz_world(context):
    """Return the Gazebo world include action."""
    pkg_ros_gz_sim = get_package_share_directory('ros_gz_sim')
    return [
        IncludeLaunchDescription(
            PythonLaunchDescriptionSource(
                os.path.join(pkg_ros_gz_sim, 'launch', 'gz_sim.launch.py')
            ),
            launch_arguments={'gz_args': 'empty.sdf -r'}.items(),
        )
    ]


def gazebo_nodes():
    """Return the list of actions needed to start Gazebo simulation."""
    return [
        OpaqueFunction(function=set_gz_sim_resource_path),
        OpaqueFunction(function=get_gz_world),
        Node(
            package='ros_gz_bridge',
            executable='parameter_bridge',
            arguments=['/clock@rosgraph_msgs/msg/Clock[gz.msgs.Clock'],
            output='screen',
        ),
    ]


def get_controller_nodes(simulate_in_gazebo, namespace):
    """Return the list of controller spawner nodes."""
    if simulate_in_gazebo:
        full_body_controller_node_parameters = [
            PathJoinSubstitution(
                [
                    FindPackageShare('franka_gazebo_bringup'),
                    'config',
                    'franka_gazebo_controllers.yaml',
                ]
            ),
        ]
        spawn = Node(
            package='ros_gz_sim',
            executable='create',
            namespace=namespace,
            arguments=[
                '-topic',
                '/robot_description',
                '-x',
                '0',
                '-y',
                '0',
                '-z',
                '0.05',
            ],
            output='screen',
        )

        mobile_fr3_duo_controller = Node(
            package='controller_manager',
            executable='spawner',
            arguments=[
                'joint_state_broadcaster',
                'swerve_ik_controller',
                'swerve_drive_controller',
                'full_body_controller',
                '--inactive',
                '--controller-manager-timeout',
                '120',
                '--service-call-timeout',
                '60',
                '--controller-ros-args',
                '--remap joint_states:=/franka/joint_states',
            ],
            parameters=full_body_controller_node_parameters,
            output='screen',
        )

        return [
            spawn,
            RegisterEventHandler(
                event_handler=OnProcessExit(
                    target_action=spawn,
                    on_exit=[mobile_fr3_duo_controller],
                )
            ),
        ]

    full_body_controller_node_parameters = [
        PathJoinSubstitution(
            [
                FindPackageShare(PACKAGE_NAME),
                'config',
                'mobile_fr3_duo_controllers.yaml',
            ]
        ),
    ]

    full_body_controller_node = Node(
        package='controller_manager',
        executable='spawner',
        arguments=[
            'joint_state_broadcaster',
            'swerve_drive_controller',
            'full_body_controller',
            '--inactive',
            '--controller-manager-timeout',
            '120',
            '--service-call-timeout',
            '60',
            '--controller-ros-args',
            '--remap joint_states:=/franka/joint_states',
        ],
        parameters=full_body_controller_node_parameters,
        output='screen',
    )

    return [full_body_controller_node]


def generate_moveit_nodes(context):
    """Generate MoveIt-specific nodes: move_group and optionally rviz."""
    simulate_in_gazebo = LaunchConfiguration('simulate_in_gazebo').perform(context)
    simulate_in_gazebo_bool = simulate_in_gazebo.lower() == 'true'
    rviz = LaunchConfiguration('rviz').perform(context)
    namespace = LaunchConfiguration('namespace', default='')

    robot_name = 'mobile_fr3_duo_v0_2'

    robot_description, robot_description_semantic = get_robot_descriptions(
        robot_name, simulate_in_gazebo
    )

    move_group_node = Node(
        package='moveit_ros_move_group',
        executable='move_group',
        namespace=namespace,
        output='screen',
        parameters=get_combined_parameters(
            robot_description,
            robot_description_semantic,
            simulate_in_gazebo_bool,
        ),
    )

    nodes = [move_group_node] + get_controller_nodes(simulate_in_gazebo_bool, namespace)

    if rviz.lower() == 'true':
        rviz_node = Node(
            package='rviz2',
            executable='rviz2',
            namespace=namespace,
            output='screen',
            respawn=False,
            arguments=[
                '-d',
                PathJoinSubstitution(
                    [
                        FindPackageShare(PACKAGE_NAME),
                        'config',
                        'moveit.rviz',
                    ]
                ),
            ],
            parameters=get_rviz_parameters(simulate_in_gazebo_bool),
        )
        nodes.append(rviz_node)

    if simulate_in_gazebo_bool:
        nodes += gazebo_nodes()

    return nodes


def generate_launch_description():
    """Entry point for this MoveIt nodes launch file."""
    return LaunchDescription(
        [
            DeclareLaunchArgument(
                'simulate_in_gazebo',
                default_value='false',
            ),
            DeclareLaunchArgument(
                'rviz',
                default_value='true',
            ),
            OpaqueFunction(function=generate_moveit_nodes),
        ]
    )

            ixz="0"
            iyy="0.001"
            iyz="0"
            izz="0.001"/>
        </inertial>
    </link>

    <joint name="planar_y" type="prismatic">
        <parent link="virtual_x" />
        <child link="virtual_y" />
        <axis xyz="0 1 0" />
        <origin rpy="0 0 0" xyz="0 0 0" />
        <limit lower="-10" upper="10" effort="1000" velocity="2" />
    </joint>
    <joint name="planar_theta" type="revolute">
        <parent link="virtual_y" />
        <child link="base_link" />
        <axis xyz="0 0 1" />
        <origin rpy="0 0 0" xyz="0 0 0" />
        <limit lower="-3.14159" upper="3.14159" effort="1000" velocity="2" />
    </joint>

    <!-- Per-arm prefixes shared by the layer-1 transmission injection and ros2_control below -->
    <xacro:property name="arm_prefixes_list" value="${['left','right']}"/>

    <!-- Self-collision capsules are emitted for planning; the Gazebo backend suppresses them. -->
    <xacro:property name="self_collision_geometry" value="$(arg include_self_collision_geometry)"/>
    <xacro:if value="$(arg simulate_in_gazebo)">
        <xacro:property name="self_collision_geometry" value="false"/>
    </xacro:if>

    <xacro:mobile_fr3_duo_v0_2
        robot_types="$(arg robot_types)"
        hand="$(arg hand)"
        ee_id="$(arg ee_id)"
        include_self_collision_geometry="${self_collision_geometry}"
        reduced_version="$(arg reduced_version)"
        description_pkg="$(arg description_pkg)"
        connected_to="$(arg connected_to)"
        use_arms="$(arg use_arms)"
        no_prefix="$(arg no_prefix)"
        special_connection="$(arg special_connection)"
        xyz_ee="$(arg xyz_ee)"
        rpy_ee="$(arg rpy_ee)"
        tcp_xyz="$(arg tcp_xyz)"
        tcp_rpy="$(arg tcp_rpy)"
        safety_distance="$(arg safety_distance)"
        with_sc="$(arg with_sc)"
    >
        <arm0_extras>
            <xacro:if value="$(arg simulate_in_gazebo)">
                <xacro:franka_gazebo_transmissions robot_type="${robot_types_list[1]}"
                    arm_prefix="${arm_prefixes_list[0]}_" ee_id="$(arg ee_id)" hand="$(arg hand)"/>
            </xacro:if>
        </arm0_extras>
        <arm1_extras>
            <xacro:if value="$(arg simulate_in_gazebo)">
                <xacro:franka_gazebo_transmissions robot_type="${robot_types_list[2]}"
                    arm_prefix="${arm_prefixes_list[1]}_" ee_id="$(arg ee_id)" hand="$(arg hand)"/>
            </xacro:if>
        </arm1_extras>
    </xacro:mobile_fr3_duo_v0_2>

    <!-- ros2_control hardware interfaces -->
    <xacro:unless value="$(arg simulate_in_gazebo)">
        <!-- TMR mobile base ros2_control -->
        <xacro:tmrv0_2_ros2_control
            mobile_robot_type="${robot_types_list[0]}"
            include_passive_base="false"
            is_async="$(arg is_async)"
            thread_priority="$(arg thread_priority)">
          <hardware_plugin>
            <xacro:tmrv0_2_selected_hardware_plugin
                use_fake_hardware="$(arg use_fake_hardware)"
                robot_ip="${robot_ips_list[0]}"
                fake_sensor_commands="$(arg fake_sensor_commands)"/>
          </hardware_plugin>
        </xacro:tmrv0_2_ros2_control>

        <!-- Per-arm ros2_control -->
        <xacro:franka_arm_ros2_control
            robot_type="${robot_types_list[1]}"
            include_effort_command="true"
            include_finger_joint="false"
            arm_prefix="${arm_prefixes_list[0]}_"
            is_async="$(arg is_async)"
            thread_priority="$(arg thread_priority)">
          <hardware_plugin>
            <xacro:franka_selected_arm_hardware_plugin
                use_fake_hardware="$(arg use_fake_hardware)"
                robot_ip="${robot_ips_list[1]}"
                arm_prefix="${arm_prefixes_list[0]}_"
                fake_sensor_commands="$(arg fake_sensor_commands)"/>
          </hardware_plugin>
        </xacro:franka_arm_ros2_control>

        <xacro:franka_arm_ros2_control
            robot_type="${robot_types_list[2]}"
            include_effort_command="true"
            include_finger_joint="false"
            arm_prefix="${arm_prefixes_list[1]}_"
            is_async="$(arg is_async)"
            thread_priority="$(arg thread_priority)">
          <hardware_plugin>
            <xacro:franka_selected_arm_hardware_plugin
                use_fake_hardware="$(arg use_fake_hardware)"
                robot_ip="${robot_ips_list[2]}"
                arm_prefix="${arm_prefixes_list[1]}_"
                fake_sensor_commands="$(arg fake_sensor_commands)"/>
          </hardware_plugin>
        </xacro:franka_arm_ros2_control>
    </xacro:unless>

    <!-- Gazebo backend: gz_ros2_control drives the controller_manager from inside the spawned
         description (the sim launch starts no ros2_control_node of its own). Each ros2_control
         block is paired with a gz_ros2_control system element; effort interfaces follow gazebo_effort. -->
    <xacro:if value="$(arg simulate_in_gazebo)">
        <!-- Unified ros2_control for gazebo (mobile base + both arms in one block) -->
        <xacro:mobile_fr3_duo_ros2_control
            mobile_robot_type="tmrv0_2"
            robot_types="${robot_types_list}"
            arm_prefixes="${arm_prefixes_list}"
            include_effort_command="$(arg gazebo_effort)"
            include_finger_joint="$(arg hand)"
            include_passive_base="true"
            is_async="$(arg is_async)"
            thread_priority="$(arg thread_priority)">
          <hardware_plugin>
            <xacro:franka_gazebo_hardware_plugin gazebo_effort="$(arg gazebo_effort)"/>
          </hardware_plugin>
        </xacro:mobile_fr3_duo_ros2_control>
        <xacro:franka_gazebo_ros2_control_system/>
    </xacro:if>


</robot>

### Default parts of the message
std_msgs/Header header

### Indicates which dimensions have an active contact/collision flag raised
CollisionIndicators collision_indicators

### The state of the arm in joint space
# The joint state consisting out of position (q), velocity (dq) and effort (tau_J)
sensor_msgs/JointState measured_joint_state

# The desired joint state consisting out of position (q_d), velocity (dq_d) and effort (tau_J_d)
sensor_msgs/JointState desired_joint_state

# The measured motor state of the joints consisting out of position (theta) and velocity (dtheta)
sensor_msgs/JointState measured_joint_motor_state

# The desired joint acceleration
float64[7] ddq_d
# The derivative of the measured torque signal
float64[7] dtau_j
# Filtered external torque. The JointState consists out of effort (tau_ext_hat_filtered)
sensor_msgs/JointState tau_ext_hat_filtered

### The state of the elbow
Elbow elbow

### The active wrenches acting on the stiffness frame expressed relative to
# stiffness frame
geometry_msgs/WrenchStamped k_f_ext_hat_k
# base frame
geometry_msgs/WrenchStamped o_f_ext_hat_k

### The different inertias of the arm
# The end-effector inertia
geometry_msgs/InertiaStamped inertia_ee
# The load inertia
geometry_msgs/InertiaStamped inertia_load
# The total (end-effector + load) inertia
geometry_msgs/InertiaStamped inertia_total

### The poses describing the transformations between different frames of the arm
# Measured end-effector pose in base frame
geometry_msgs/PoseStamped o_t_ee
# Last desired end-effector pose of motion generation in base frame
geometry_msgs/PoseStamped o_t_ee_d
# Last commanded end-effector pose of motion generation in base frame
geometry_msgs/PoseStamped o_t_ee_c
# Flange to end-effector frame
geometry_msgs/PoseStamped f_t_ee
# End-effector to stiffness frame
geometry_msgs/PoseStamped ee_t_k

# Desired end effector twist in base frame
geometry_msgs/TwistStamped o_dp_ee_d
# Last commanded end effector twist in base frame
geometry_msgs/TwistStamped o_dp_ee_c
# Last commanded end effector acceleration in base frame

float64 control_command_success_rate

## The status of a motion action
# IDLE: The robot is idle, no motion is being executed
uint8 IDLE = 0

# EXECUTING: The robot is currently executing the motion
uint8 EXECUTING = 1

# TARGET_REACHED: The robot has reached the target position given two conditions:
# - the absolute difference between the current and goal joint positions is within the goal_tolerance
# - the joint velocities are below a small threshold
uint8 TARGET_REACHED = 2

# ABORTED: The motion was aborted due to an error or external intervention
uint8 ABORTED = 3

## The current status of the motion (one of the above states)
uint8 status

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Filter compile_commands.json to only include franka_* packages."""

import json
import os
import sys


def filter_compile_commands(input_file, output_file, pattern='franka_'):
    """
    Filter compile_commands.json to only include packages matching pattern.

    Reduces clang-tidy analysis scope by filtering the compilation database
    to only include entries for Franka packages, excluding third-party
    libraries (gtest, ROS2, etc). This significantly accelerates clang-tidy
    execution.

    Parameters
    ----------
    input_file : str
        Path to compile_commands.json to filter
    output_file : str
        Path to write filtered database
    pattern : str, optional
        Package name pattern to include (default: 'franka_')

    """
    with open(input_file, 'r') as f:
        commands = json.load(f)

    # Filter entries to only include franka_* packages
    filtered = []
    for entry in commands:
        file_path = entry.get('file', '')
        # Only include files that contain pattern in path (our code)
        if f'/src/{pattern}' in file_path or f'/{pattern}' in file_path:
            filtered.append(entry)

    # Backup original and replace with filtered version
    backup_file = input_file.replace('.json', '_original.json')
    if not os.path.exists(backup_file):
        import shutil
        shutil.copy(input_file, backup_file)

    with open(input_file, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(filtered, f, indent=2)

    if output_file != input_file:
        with open(output_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(filtered, f, indent=2)

    print(f'Filtered {len(commands)} entries to {len(filtered)} entries')
    if output_file != input_file:
        print(f'Written to {output_file}')


def restore_compile_commands(build_dir):
    """
    Restore compile_commands.json from backup if it exists.

    Used for cleanup after testing or to revert to full analysis scope.
    Restores the original unfiltered compilation database for cases where
    full clang-tidy analysis is needed.

    Parameters
    ----------
    build_dir : str
        Build directory containing compile_commands.json

    """
    input_file = os.path.join(build_dir, 'compile_commands.json')
    backup_file = input_file.replace('.json', '_original.json')

    if os.path.exists(backup_file):
        import shutil
        shutil.copy(backup_file, input_file)
        print(f'Restored {input_file} from backup')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print('Usage: .filter_compile_commands.py <build_dir> [--restore]')
        sys.exit(1)

    build_dir = sys.argv[1]
    restore_mode = '--restore' in sys.argv
    input_file = os.path.join(build_dir, 'compile_commands.json')

    if restore_mode:
        restore_compile_commands(build_dir)
        sys.exit(0)

    if not os.path.exists(input_file):
        print(f'Error: {input_file} not found')
        sys.exit(1)

    # Replace compile_commands.json in place
    filter_compile_commands(input_file, input_file)
